root_cause: The OPT-GPTQ model (katuni4ka/opt-125m-gptq) export test failed accuracy comparison between PyTorch and OpenVINO outputs. The model uses GPTQ 4-bit quantization (via AutoGPTQ/GPT-QModel 6.0.3 with TorchFusedQuantLinear kernel). The export produces an OV model but the results diverge from the PyTorch reference at inference time, failing the compare_results assertion. This could be due to a regression in the GPTQ quantization path, a change in how compressed weights are exported, or a mismatch in dequantization logic between the PyTorch and OV execution paths.
recommended_actions: Investigate recent changes to the OPT/GPTQ export path in the PyTorch frontend or nncf/openvino-genai stack
Check if GPT-QModel 6.0.3 or Transformers 5.5.3 has changed its quantization output format
Run compare_results locally to inspect the magnitude of the output discrepancy
Check git blame on test_llm.py compare_results and the GPTQ export path for recent changes
prevention_strategies: Add numerical tolerance assertions for GPTQ models; pin model/library versions used in export tests
historical_context: This same test failure was seen 2 prior times today (runs 30264014436 and 30261291251), associated with PRs #36860 and #37029. This is now the 3rd occurrence in 12 hours.
